status: Specified before any SIFT-VLAD feature or gender-attribute outcome was computed or inspected.
cohort: Existing CSAFE 96-writer balanced-handedness cohort, same pages and roles as csafe_replication_2026-11-08.

matcher.name: SIFT-VLAD
matcher.image: grayscale page resized to width 1600 px (INTER_AREA)
matcher.keypoints: OpenCV SIFT, nfeatures=4000, default contrast/edge thresholds
matcher.descriptor: RootSIFT (L1 normalisation then elementwise square root)
matcher.codebook_pages: session-1 LND repetition 2 and WOZ repetition 2 of every writer (never gallery or query pages; unsupervised, no labels)
matcher.pca: 64 components fitted on 300 random descriptors per codebook page, seed 20261109
matcher.vlad: residual sums, intra-normalisation, signed square root, global L2
matcher.whitening: PCA whitening to 128 dimensions fitted on codebook-page VLADs, then L2
matcher.matching: identical to the other representations: gallery-reference standardisation, L2, cosine

attributes.handedness: existing primary HC-183 writer-held-out predictor (refitted, must reproduce archived logits)
attributes.gender: survey field 'gender' (female 63, male 33); HC-183 linear SVM C=0.1 with the identical outer/development/calibration hierarchy; label 1 = female

random_partition: exact expectation C(H_opp, j)/C(N-1, j) with H_opp the size of the query's opposite attribute group
estimand: equal writer weights (equivalently hand-balanced in this 48/48 cohort); hand-stratified writer bootstrap 10,000 draws, 9,999 sign flips
primary_family: 16 contrasts with Holm correction: (a) handedness with SIFT-VLAD identity, fixed and nested vs identity, session-2 same and different prompt (4); (b) gender with ResNet-18, ViT-B/16 and SIFT-VLAD identity, fixed and nested vs identity, both session-2 conditions (12)
secondary: session 3, HC-183 and STROKE identity features, hard filter, known attribute, random partition, precision (90% CI, smallest equivalence margin), j=1 opposite-group share
scope: post hoc extension added in response to an internal review; reported as such
